oldSourceRecord.title: Store and retrieve embeddings in Azure Cosmos DB
oldSourceRecord.shortSummary: Stores embeddings alongside content/metadata and configures dimension/path/distance policies. The unit's float16 discussion is excluded; the product policy supports float32, int8, and uint8.

newSourceRecord.title: Store and retrieve embeddings in Azure Cosmos DB
newSourceRecord.shortSummary: Explains storing embeddings with content and metadata and configuring vector path, type, dimensions, and distance. The frozen training and product policies include float32, float16, int8, and uint8. Float16 can reduce the vectors' storage footprint with possible accuracy loss; workload-independent negligible-loss guarantees are not supported.

semanticAndApprovalChanges.oldValue: Cosmos vector-storage training claims float16 support; the current product policy lists float32/int8/uint8. Do not author float16 support from that unit.
semanticAndApprovalChanges.newValue: The frozen Cosmos vector-policy product and training receipts both list float32, float16, int8, and uint8. The earlier unsupported-float16 exclusion was a curation error; see correction-history.json. Float16 can reduce vector storage with possible accuracy loss. Do not claim negligible search-quality loss for every workload or a 50% reduction in total database size, memory, Request Units, or cost.
